players.bio: Alexander John Hunt (born 29 May 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for York City. Alex Hunt joined the Owls Academy at the age of seven where he would go on to become the club captain of the under-18s.
Alexander Lewis Newby (born 21 November 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays for EFL League Two club York City as a midfielder.
Alfie McNally is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club York City, on loan from Premier League side Fulham.
Arthur Read is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League Two club York City.

Ashley John Palmer (born 9 November 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for club Halifax Town on loan from York City. Palmer progressed through the Barnsley youth ranks but was released in February 2009 and signed for Scunthorpe United where he became youth team captain. Palmer signed his first professional contract in June 2010 on a one year deal.
Ben Brookes is a 25-year-old professional left-back who is contractually signed with York City F.C. but is currently out on loan at National League side Sutton United F.C. until December 2026.
Charlie McArthur is a 21-year-old Scottish professional footballer who plays as a defender for York City F.C., though he has recently joined National League side Woking F.C. on a short-term loan.
Craig Hewitt is a 23-year-old professional footballer who plays as a left midfielder or forward for EFL League Two club York City F.C.

Afolabi Oladipo Christopher "Dipo" Akinyemi (born 10 June 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club York City. Akinyemi began his career in the youth academy at Potters Bar Town in 2011, breaking into the first team in 2014. He joined Stevenage's academy at the end of that year, before making his first-team debut at the start of the 2015–16 season.

Frankie Maguire is a 23-year-old English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for York City F.C. in EFL League Two. He officially completed a transfer to the Minstermen on 1 July 2026 following a highly productive stint with Boston United.

George William Sykes-Kenworthy (born 1 October 1999) is an English semi-professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club York City. Sykes-Kenworthy began his career with Bradford City, spending time on loan at non-league clubs Stalybridge Celtic, Stafford Rangers and Guiseley.
Harry Boyes (born 2 November 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left wing-back for EFL League Two club York City
Hiram Kojo Kwarteng Boateng (born 8 January 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for York City.
Jack Paul Hunt (born 6 December 1990) is an English professional footballer who plays for EFL League Two club York City. Though primarily a right back, Hunt can also play on the right of midfield.

Jeff King (born 19 December 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club York City. King started his career in non-league playing for Altrincham, Prescot Cables, Nantwich Town, Kendal Town, Trafford, Ashton United, Witton Albion and Droylsden, before joining the academy of Bolton Wanderers.
Joe Felix is a 27-year-old professional footballer who plays as a right-back and wing-back for EFL League Two club York City F.C..
Joe Grey is a 23-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a forward or attacking midfielder for EFL League Two club York City F.C..

Josh David Stones (born 12 November 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for York City. Stones began his career with Guiseley, before moving to Wigan Athletic. He had loan spells at Ross County and Oldham Athletic before transferring to York City.
Jovan Anthony Malcolm is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club York City, on loan from EFL League One club Stevenage.

Mark Kitching (born 4 September 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back, centre-back, or left midfielder for EFL League Two club York City. Standing at 6 ft 3 in (1.91 m), the versatile defender is known for his defensive prowess, aerially dominant presence, and ability to contribute effectively in the attacking third.

Mark Shelton is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League Two club Grimsby Town F.C., on loan from fellow League Two side York City F.C.. Shelton came through the ranks at Burton Albion, signing his first professional contract in May 2015. He continued his career in non-League, initially with Ilkeston and Alfreton Town.
Morgan Gerald Williams (born 30 August 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a center-back for EFL League Two club York City F.C.

Oliver Ian Banks (born 21 September 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder. Banks formerly played for Rotherham United, Sheffield, Buxton, Stalybridge Celtic, Gainsborough Trinity, Scarborough Athletic, North Ferriby United, FC United of Manchester, Chesterfield, Northampton Town, Oldham Athletic, Tranmere Rovers, Swindon Town and Barrow.

Ollie Pearce is a prolific 31-year-old forward who currently plays as the number 10 for York City F.C. in EFL League Two. He established himself as a club talisman and a fan favourite during the team’s rapid rise under manager Scott Lindsey.

Ryan Jack Glenn Fallowfield (born 3 January 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right back for EFL League Two club York City. Fallowfield started his career at Hull City, though did not make a senior appearance, and has also played for North Ferriby United.
Scott Lindsey is an English professional football manager and former player who is currently the head coach of EFL League Two club York City.
Zak Robert Johnson (born 30 July 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club York City.
Zechariah Joshua Henry Medley (born 9 July 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club York City.
